title: The Supreme Pursuit of the Heart
description: “What comes into our minds when we think about God is the most important thing about us.” — A.W. Tozer

blocks.html:
“Let not the wise man boast in his wisdom…But let the one who boasts boast in this: that he understands and knows me.”
— Jeremiah 9:23-24 (NET)
“What comes into our minds when we think about God is the most important thing about us.” — A.W. Tozer

“In the quiet sanctuary of the human heart, few pursuits are more vital than the earnest contemplation of who God truly is. The more we know about God, the more we will love Him, trust Him, and obey Him. Understanding His character is the foundation for a victorious Christian life.” — Dr. Bill Bright

“God has revealed His character to us in His Word so that we might know Him personally and walk with Him intimately. When we understand who God is—His love, His holiness, His power, His faithfulness—we are transformed. I am convinced that the greatest need of the church today is for believers to have a fresh vision of the greatness and glory of God. When we see God as He really is, our problems shrink and our faith grows.” — Dr. Bill Bright

This book is an invitation to that fresh vision. Across the following chapters, we will explore twenty key attributes of God, grouped into four foundational categories. These are not distant theological concepts, but living realities that shape how we pray, how we endure trials, how we love others, and how we face each new day.
These attributes reveal the independent, self-sufficient nature of God. He depends on nothing outside Himself. He is the eternal Source from whom all things flow.
Here we behold God’s supreme rule over all creation. His power, knowledge, and presence are exercised with perfect authority and unwavering faithfulness.
These attributes display the moral perfection and integrity of God. His holiness is the radiant purity from which justice, righteousness, and truth flow without flaw.
In this final section, we marvel at God’s benevolent heart. His love is not abstract but actively expressed through mercy, grace, goodness, and perfect wisdom.
“Once you become aware that the main business that you are here for is to know God, most of life’s problems fall into place of their own accord.” — J.I. Packer
“Plunge yourself in the Godhead’s deepest sea… I know nothing which can so comfort the soul… as a devout musing upon the subject of the Godhead.” — Charles Spurgeon

It is our prayer that as you journey through these pages, the Holy Spirit will open your eyes to behold the Lord in fresh and transformative ways. May your knowledge of God move from the mind to the heart, producing deeper worship, stronger faith, greater obedience, and abiding peace.
For our God is worthy — infinitely worthy — of our highest thoughts, our deepest love, and our most wholehearted devotion.

title: Attributes of Self-Existence
description: At the very foundation of all that we can know about God lies a profound and awe-inspiring reality: God is self-existent.

blocks.html: At the very foundation of all that we can know about God lies a profound and awe-inspiring reality: God is self-existent.

This category of attributes reveals the eternal, independent, and utterly unique nature of our Creator. While everything in creation depends on something else for its existence, God depends on nothing and no one outside Himself. He simply is.

These five attributes — Self-Existent, Eternal, Infinite, Transcendent, and Spirit — form the bedrock upon which all other truths about God rest. They declare that God is the uncaused Cause, the eternal Source, and the self-sufficient One from whom all life and reality flow.
He depends on nothing for His being; He is the great “I AM.”
Because God is self-existent, I can rest securely in Him, knowing He is my Creator and Sustainer.
He exists outside the boundaries of time with no beginning and no end.
Because God is eternal, I can face each day with patient hope, knowing my labors in His kingdom hold lasting value beyond this fleeting life.
He is without any limits in His being, power, knowledge, mercy, love, and presence.
Because God is infinite, I can approach every limitation in my life with confident expectation, drawing from His boundless resources.
He exists high above and beyond all creation, distinct from it while sustaining it.
Because God is transcendent, I can trust His higher ways when my understanding fails, submitting my plans to His perfect wisdom.
He is purely immaterial, invisible, and unbound by physical limitations.
Because God is Spirit, I can worship Him sincerely in every moment, free from dependence on external forms or places.

These attributes of self-existence reveal the majestic otherness of God. He is not a larger version of us, nor is He dependent on the universe He created. He is the Fountainhead of all existence, complete in Himself within the perfect fellowship of the Trinity.

To meditate on God’s self-existence is to be humbled by our total dependence and comforted by His gracious invitation to know and walk with Him. In a world that constantly changes and fails us, we find security in the God who has always been fully sufficient and who generously sustains every breath we take.

title: Attributes of Sovereignty
description: At the heart of God’s interaction with creation lies a majestic and comforting reality: God is sovereign.

blocks.html: At the heart of God’s interaction with creation lies a majestic and comforting reality: God is sovereign.

This category of attributes reveals His supreme rule and active authority over all things. While human rulers rise and fall, and earthly powers are limited and temporary, God reigns unchallenged as the King of kings. He holds absolute power, perfect knowledge, constant presence, and unchanging faithfulness.

These five attributes — Sovereign, All-Powerful, All-Knowing, Present Everywhere, and Unchanging — declare that nothing is outside His wise and purposeful governance. He works all things according to the counsel of His will for His glory and the ultimate good of His people.
He exercises absolute rule over all creation.
Because God is sovereign, I can surrender my anxieties and plans to Him, resting in His wise rule over every detail of my life.
Nothing is too difficult for Him.
Because God is all-powerful, I can bring every impossibility to Him in prayer, trusting His strength to accomplish what I cannot.
He knows all things perfectly.
Because God is all-knowing, I can live with complete honesty before Him, finding peace in being fully understood and loved.
He is fully present in every place at all times.
Because God is present everywhere, I can experience His nearness in every place and situation, never truly alone.
His character and purposes remain constant forever.
Because God is unchanging, I can depend on His character and promises even when circumstances shift around me.

These attributes together assure us that the universe is not governed by chance, fate, or human ambition, but by the steady hand of a holy, wise, and loving King. In a world that often feels chaotic and out of control, God’s sovereignty offers profound peace and calls us to humble, joyful submission.
To know that the same God who rules the stars also watches over our lives is one of the greatest comforts of the Christian faith.

title: Attributes of Holiness
description: At the very center of God’s moral perfection shines the radiant attribute of holiness.

blocks.html: At the very center of God’s moral perfection shines the radiant attribute of holiness.

This category reveals the flawless integrity and ethical purity of our God. While His sovereignty displays His supreme rule and His love reveals His benevolent heart, His holiness shows us that He is utterly separate from all sin and perfectly righteous in every way.

These five attributes — Holy, Righteous, Just, Faithful, and Absolute Truth — form the moral foundation of His character. They declare that God is not only great in power, but perfectly good in all His ways. In a world filled with moral confusion and compromise, God’s holiness stands as the unchanging standard of what is right, true, and pure.
He is perfectly pure and set apart from all sin.
Because God is holy, I can pursue purity in my thoughts and actions, approaching Him with reverent awe.
All His ways and decisions are morally perfect.
Because God is righteous, I can strive to reflect His moral perfection in my daily conduct and relationships.
He renders perfect fairness in every judgment.
Because God is just, I can act with fairness and integrity, trusting Him to right every wrong in His perfect time.
He never fails to keep His promises or covenants.
Because God is faithful, I can remain steadfast in my commitments, modeling His reliability in my relationships.
He is the source and unchanging standard of all truth.
Because God is absolute truth, I can speak and live with honesty, anchoring my life to His unchanging Word.

These attributes of holiness together paint a breathtaking portrait of a God who is morally flawless. His holiness is not cold or distant — it is the beautiful light that exposes darkness, calls us to purity, and draws us near through the cleansing work of Christ.

To understand God’s holiness is to be humbled by His perfection and comforted by His grace. It invites us not only to worship Him, but to reflect His holy character in our daily lives — pursuing integrity, justice, faithfulness, and truth in a world that desperately needs to see them.

title: Attributes of Love
description: At the radiant center of God’s character shines the glorious reality that God is love.

blocks.html: At the radiant center of God’s character shines the glorious reality that God is love.

This category of attributes reveals the benevolent, compassionate, and redemptive heart of our Creator. While His self-existence shows His independence, His sovereignty displays His rule, and His holiness reveals His moral purity, God’s love expresses His generous desire for relationship and the highest good of His people.

These five attributes — Love, Merciful, Gracious, Good, and Wise — flow from the very heart of God and invite us into a personal, transforming relationship with Him. They remind us that the almighty, holy God is not distant or indifferent, but actively good toward us in Christ.
His very essence is self-giving, sacrificial love.
Because God is love, I can extend compassion and forgiveness freely to others as a reflection of His heart.
He withholds the punishment we deserve out of tender compassion.
Because God is merciful, I can approach Him boldly after failure and extend mercy to those who wrong me.
He freely bestows unearned favor and kindness upon the undeserving.
Because God is gracious, I can rest from striving to earn His favor and serve Him from a heart of thankfulness.
He is the source and definition of all goodness, delighting to bless His creation.
Because God is good, I can look for His kindness in every day and respond with a grateful heart.
He orders all things with perfect wisdom for the highest good of those He loves.
Because God is wise, I can seek His guidance in every decision, trusting His ways lead to what is best.

These attributes of love together paint a beautiful portrait of a God whose heart overflows with kindness, mercy, and redemptive purpose. In a broken world filled with pain and rejection, God’s love offers healing, security, and hope.

To know that the same God who is holy and sovereign is also perfectly loving is one of the greatest comforts of the Christian faith. It calls us not only to receive His love with open hearts, but to reflect it in our relationships — extending mercy, grace, goodness, and wisdom to others as a living testimony of who He is.

title: Live in the Light of His Majesty
description: As we come to the close of this journey through the attributes of our great God, let us pause in reverent wonder. We have not merely studied ideas about…

blocks.html: As we come to the close of this journey through the attributes of our great God, let us pause in reverent wonder. We have not merely studied ideas about the Almighty; we have beheld glimpses of His magnificent character — the self-sufficient Source of all existence, the sovereign Ruler of history, the holy and righteous One, and the God whose very nature is love.
Attributes of Self-Existence have shown us the independent, self-sufficient God who simply is — the uncaused Cause and eternal Fountain from whom all life flows. In Him we find our security and rest.

Attributes of Sovereignty (Power and Authority) have revealed the King who rules over all with perfect wisdom and power. In a chaotic world, we rest in His wise governance and surrender our anxieties to Him.

Attributes of Holiness have displayed the flawless moral purity of our God. His holiness calls us to purity while His righteousness, justice, faithfulness, and truth provide the unshakable standard for our lives.

Attributes of Love have unveiled the benevolent heart of the Father. His love, mercy, grace, goodness, and wisdom invite us into an intimate relationship and empower us to reflect His kindness to a hurting world.

Together, these twenty attributes paint a breathtaking portrait of the one true God—majestic in power, perfect in holiness, and overflowing in love. He is not distant or unknowable. He has revealed Himself so that we might know Him, love Him, and walk with Him.

Let this study not end with admiration alone. May it lead to deeper worship, humble obedience, and transformed living. Let the self-existent God free you from self-reliance. Let the sovereign King calm your fears. Let the holy God purify your heart. Let the God who is love fill you with compassion for others.

May the Holy Spirit continue to open your eyes to behold the Lord in fresh and transformative ways. May your knowledge of God move from the mind to the heart, producing deeper worship, stronger faith, greater obedience, and abiding peace.
For our God is worthy—infinitely worthy—of our highest thoughts, our deepest love, and our most wholehearted devotion.
To Him be glory, honor, and praise forever. Amen.
